'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Nate Louderback DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nate Louderback]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Username:''' dorshe1
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
